project.name: backend-links
project.description: Leaf slice (specs/035): links between Alfreds on the LAN, the cycle and board streams one Alfred offers another, the requests a reader sends the owner, the owner's read log, board environments and an environment Alfred's own marks, step ticks and re-tests. One connection per link (a WebSocket the dialing side opens), multiplexed: relayed reads with chunked bodies and credit, durable events with a cursor, signals. Its own links.db - configuration and requests only, never streamed data. backend-app/linksbridge answers a peer's reads from the other slices; nothing else depends on it. Hexagonal internally (domain/application/adapter packages under com.fathy.alfred.backend.links).
